_umap_options.name: Grocery Stores
_umap_options.description:
Unlike convenience stores, which focus on quick, smaller purchases like snacks and drinks, grocery stores provide a more extensive range of food and household essentials. They have a wide selection of fresh produce, meats, and pantry staples, making them ideal for larger shopping trips. 

Many of the grocery stores located on this map are accessible either by bus or the PTS Shuttle program.
